brief_verbatim:
Shared style block (start every slide prompt with this)
Heavy Haul loading-screen slide. Landscape PNG, 1536 × 1024 px or larger, fully opaque. Same painted look as assets/loaders/source/slide-bog.png: a premium semi-realistic painted game illustration of a misty cypress swamp at dusk, cool blue-grey light, warm headlights and orange sunset glow, heavy wet mud, moss, cypress knees and weathered steel. Dark and serious, SnowRunner-like, never cartoony or glossy.

Layout: the bottom 28% of the image fades smoothly to near-black (#090b0e) with nothing important in it, because game text and a loading wheel sit there. Keep every truck, arrow and label inside the middle 70% of the width and between 8% and 70% of the height, because phones crop the sides.

Tutorial overlay, painted into the image in one style on every slide: bright warm-amber (#f2a531) arrows with a soft glow and a thin dark outline; dashed amber rings or brackets around the thing they point at; and labels on small dark rounded plates (#0d1014 at 85%) in bold condensed sans-serif ALL CAPS white text, like Barlow Condensed Bold. Use at most 4 labels, each 1–4 words, spelled exactly as given and nothing more. The overlay reads like a game’s how-to-play screen, not a poster.

Avoid: logos, brand names, number plates with text, watermarks, UI frames, extra words, people’s faces.

1. source/slide-bog-v2.png: deep mud (your favourite, redone)
[style block] Remake slide-bog.png as closely as possible: the same six-wheel canvas-covered army truck churning through a deep mud bog, the same trees, light and composition. Add the overlay: an amber ring around the front wheels labelled 4×4; a bracket spanning all six wheels labelled DIFF LOCK; a small gear-stick icon plate near the cab labelled LOW GEAR L; and a dashed outline around the deep dark mud ahead, with an arrow into it labelled DEEP BOG.

2. source/slide-winch-v2.png: breakdown truck rescue
[style block] Side-three-quarter view: a heavy cargo truck sunk to its axles in a bog. Behind it on firmer ground, a rugged swamp breakdown truck (boom, winch drum and tow hook at its rear, amber beacons on) has reversed up close, and a taut steel cable runs from its rear winch to the stuck truck’s front hook. Overlay: a dimension line with arrow tips between the two trucks labelled WITHIN 5 m; a ring around the winch drum labelled TAP WINCH; and a long curved arrow pointing away from the bog in the breakdown truck’s driving direction labelled DRIVE AWAY TO TOW.

3. source/slide-fuel-v2.png: fuel station
[style block] A small weathered swamp fuel station on a gravel pad at the trail’s edge: one old pump with a hose, a corrugated-steel lean-to with tools and spare tires, and a lamp glowing. A muddy, dented pickup-sized truck is pulled up beside the pump. Overlay: an amber ring around the pump labelled REFUEL; a wrench icon over the truck’s dented fender labelled REPAIR; and, far away along the muddy trail behind, a faint second pump marked with a small amber pin labelled NEXT STATION.

4. source/slide-obstacles.png: logs, rocks and pipes
[style block] A side-on stretch of swamp trail with three obstacles in a row: a huge fallen log, a cluster of big boulders, and a thick rusty pipeline crossing the track. A big-tired off-road truck has its front wheels up on the pipe. Overlay: an amber ring around the truck’s tire labelled BIG TIRES CLIMB; a dashed arc over the pipe labelled PIPES & LOGS; and an arrow at the boulders labelled PICK YOUR LINE.

5. source/slide-coins.png: crush and earn
[style block] A heavy truck rolling over and crushing small breakable things on a dirt stretch (rotten crates, a rusty barrel, dead saplings), with splinters flying. Small glowing gold coins pop up from the wreckage and from the fresh ground ahead. Overlay: an arrow at the crushed crates labelled CRUSH FOR COINS; an arrow along the untouched trail ahead labelled NEW GROUND PAYS; and a coin icon next to a bog behind the truck labelled CLEAR BOGS.

6. source/slide-garage-v2.png: tune and power up
[style block] Interior of a dim, rainy marsh garage workshop at night: a mud-caked truck on the floor, its hood up and suspension visible, with tools, spare tires and work lamps around it. Overlay: four small round icon plates around the truck, each with a thin leader line, labelled ENGINE (engine block), SUSPENSION (coil spring), SPEED (gauge) and GRIP (tire tread). That is all four labels; no others.

Loading-wheel mud (transparent, side view)
All four: transparent-background PNG with real alpha (no checkerboard, no halo, no ground or shadow beyond the mud itself). Flat side view. The same wet dark-brown swamp mud as slide-bog.png, with glossy wet highlights, bits of grass and small stones. No wheel, truck or text.

source/loader-mud-mound.png, 1600 × 600 px: a low, wide, lumpy mound of churned mud. The top is fairly flat in the middle, where a wheel will spin, with a shallow rut groove and torn edges. It’s widest at the base and nothing touches the canvas edges.
source/loader-splash-1.png, -2.png, -3.png, each 1024 × 1024 px: a spray of mud flung up and back to the left, as if thrown off a spinning tire. The three are different moments: (1) a tight fresh burst near the bottom-right, (2) mid-flight clumps and droplets fanning out, (3) scattered falling drops and thin streaks. Each spray starts from the bottom-right corner area and nothing is cut off at the edges.
